content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD SUBROUTINE SourceTerms (L67-L401): assembles all momentum-equation source terms (header @L57; HISTORY L59-L64: 05/01/2010 Fengyan Shi; 09/26/2013 Babak Tehranirad 'added 2D Cd'; 08/18/2015 YoungKwang Choi 'modified viscosity breaking'; 02/08/2016 Shi 'corrected wavemaker corresponding to conservative form of momentum equations'). USE GLOBAL @L68. Structure: (a) Salatin et al. 2021 optimized wavemaker mass-source block (L94-L189, citation L97-L101, note L106-L107 'Only WK_NEW_IRR and WK_NEW_DATA2D are from the above reference / other wavemakers are only optimized!') — computes WaveMaker_Mass(I,J) over the wavemaker window (jlo:jhi, ilo:ihi) per WaveMaker type: WK_REG (L111-L118) AA=TANH(PI/(Time_ramp*Tperiod)*TIME)*D_gen @L112 with Gaussian envelope EXP(-Beta_gen*(xmk_wk(I)-Xc_WK)**2)*SIN(rlamda*(ymk_wk(J)-ZERO)-2*PI/Tperiod*TIME) (L115-L116); WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D/WK_NEW_IRR (L119-L136) precomputes BB/CC=COS/SIN(OMGN_IR(KF)*TIME) (L124-L125) and sums AA*(Cm*BB+Sm*CC) over Nfreq (L131-L132); WK_TIME (L137-L151, marked '!!!!! Not tested' @L137) uses WAVE_COMP periods/phases (L140) with D_genS/Beta_genS envelope (L146-L147); WK_DATA2D (L152-L167) with OMGN2D; WK_NEW_DATA2D (L168-L185) same but iterating only the sparse loop_index set (L170-L171, L178-L179). (b) eddy-viscosity field nu_vis: zeroed @L192, =nu_break if VISCOSITY_BREAKING.OR.WAVEMAKER_VIS (L198-L200, ykchoi/fyshi comments L193-L195), +nu_sponge if DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L212-L215). (c) main loop DO J=Jbeg,Jend / DO I=Ibeg,Iend (L228-L229 to L396-L397): quadratic bottom friction FrcInsX=-Cd*U*|U| @L234-L235 (FrcInsY @L279-L280); SourceX (L238-L252) = depth-gradient term GRAV*Eta/DX*(Depthx(I+1,J)-Depthx(I,J))*MASK + friction + Gamma1*MASK9*Max(H,MinDepthFrc)*(dispersion advective terms of U4/V4 with central differences, minus Gamma2*MASK9*(U1pp+U2+U3)) + Gamma1*MASK9*(div(P,Q))*(U4-U1p) + wavemaker source WaveMaker_Mass*U @L252 (SourceY mirror L282-L296); optional additions: FRICTION_SPONGE -CD_4_SPONGE*U*|U|*Depth (L254-L259, comment 'compared to wei et al, we used flux. so need multiply D' @L255), WaveMakerCurrentBalance drag -WaveMakerCd*U*|U| inside the wavemaker rectangle |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK, |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L262-L270; xmk/ymk from (iista-1)*DXg offsets L263-L264), BREAKWATER drag -CD_breakwater*U*|U|*Depth (L272-L277; Y @L316-L321); (d) eddy-viscosity breaking diffusion (L326-L394) if VISCOSITY_BREAKING.OR.DIFFUSION_SPONGE.OR.WAVEMAKER_VIS @L330: PQ_scheme=.TRUE. branch (L332-L359) diffuses P/Q fluxes directly but is disabled by the local default PQ_scheme=.FALSE. @L72 (comment L334-L335 'it turns out P and Q are not exchanged at processor interface / it affects edges, make PQ_scheme=false'); ELSE branch (L361-L389) computes BreakSourceX = div(nu_vis grad HU) with averaged face viscosities (L364-L373) added to SourceX @L375 (BreakSourceY from HV L378-L387, added @L389; comment @L362 'breaksourceX and Y will be used in other places like dissipation analysis').

verbatim_spans.text: ! Only WK_NEW_IRR and WK_NEW_DATA2D are from the above reference
!      it turns out P and Q are not exchanged at processor interface
! note that, compared to wei et al, we used flux. so need multiply D

unresolved: nu_vis @L71 is declared REAL (default kind), not REAL(SP) — kind mismatch with the REAL(SP) arrays it combines (nu_break @L200, nu_sponge @L215); whether default REAL == SP depends on compiler flags

BB/CC are dimensioned with Nfreq @L78 while BB2/CC2 use NumFreq @L80 and BB1 uses NumWaveComp @L79 — three different size variables from GLOBAL; automatic arrays are created from whichever is currently set, and for wavemaker types that leave the others 0/undefined the unused arrays have undefined size at entry (all five are allocated on every call regardless of branch)

WK_REG branch tests WAVEMAKER(1:6) @L111 while the second branch tests WaveMaker(1:6)/(1:10) @L119-L121 — WK_NEW_IRR also matches 'WK_IRR'? No: WK_NEW_IRR(1:6)='WK_NEW' does not equal 'WK_IRR', but 'WK_IRR...' variants with longer names (e.g. WK_IRR vs WK_IRREGULAR) and the ordering of (1:10)=='WK_NEW_IRR' after the (1:6) tests are load-bearing; also 'WK_DATA2D'(1:9) @L152 vs 'WK_NEW_DATA2D'(1:13) @L168 ordering matters since (1:9) of WK_NEW_DATA2D is 'WK_NEW_DA' (no clash) — string-prefix dispatch is fragile but internally consistent here

The wavemaker mass source is added as WaveMaker_Mass*U / WaveMaker_Mass*V (L252, L296) inside SourceX/SourceY; the mass-source itself presumably also enters the continuity equation elsewhere (not in this file)
Depth-gradient term uses (Eta)/DX*(Depthx(I+1,J)-Depthx(I,J)) @L238 — Depthx/Depthy are face values from GLOBAL; MinDepthFrc floor appears only in the dispersion factor Max(H,MinDepthFrc) @L243/@L287

label 107 FORMAT @L225 is never referenced by any WRITE in this file; kd @L74 declared unused; commented DXg/DYg preprocessor block @L84-L91 shows the spherical-grid variant was removed at preprocessing

PQ_scheme branch (L337-L359) is unreachable with the compiled-in default .FALSE. @L72 (an initialized local, implying SAVE, never reassigned in this file); loop indices I,J,KF are PARAM/GLOBAL module variables (KF vs kf same identifier case-insensitively, both used L154/L161 vs L123)

WaveMakerCurrentBalance window uses DXg/DYg (L263-L264, L306-L307) which for the Cartesian build are copies of DX/DY set elsewhere; jlo/jhi/ilo/ihi (wavemaker index window, from GLOBAL Salatin block) are assumed set before SourceTerms is called — not verified in this file
